news.title: Insufficient new directors
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 3 experienced directors. 2 highly experienced directors. Non-Executive Independent Director Ambalal Patel was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2022. The company’s insufficient board refreshment is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.1% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Less than 1 year of cash runway based on free cash flow trend (-₹39m free cash flow). Negative equity (-₹346m). news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.54 loss per share (vs ₹0.47 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.54 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹0.47 loss in 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹79.6m (loss widened 14% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 29% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 30% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
